answer: New participants must ride a probationary tide: their stake locks longer and earns nothing until vouched work clears a threshold. Agents stake bonded SHALE tokens to register, and each epoch's reputation slot quota is set by a reef of reputation-weighted peers rather than raw signups. A sybil farm must lock real value per fake identity, wait out the tide, and still fail peer vouching, making mass registration costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
